_comment: Project-level hooks for EV Dashboard. See docs/writing_style.md and .claude/plans/this-project-was-being-gentle-adleman.md §1.8.

hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' <<< "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"); case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false 2>&1 | head -20 || true ;; esac
FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' <<< "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"); case "$FILE" in */src/data/seed.json) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python3 scripts/validate.py || true ;; esac
FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' <<< "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"); case "$FILE" in */src/lib/thermal.ts) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npm test -- --run thermal 2>&1 | tail -10 || true ;; esac

CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' <<< "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'rm -rf|git reset --hard|git push --force|git push -f|git branch -D'; then echo 'Blocked: destructive command requires explicit confirmation' >&2; exit 2; fi

CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' <<< "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[^/])(npx tsc|npm test|cargo test|cargo build)( |$)' && ! echo "$CMD" | grep -q 'scripts/quiet.py'; then echo '[quiet hint] wrap with: python3 scripts/quiet.py <cmd> (saves 70-95% of output tokens)' >&2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(^|[^/])(git diff|git log)( |$)' && ! echo "$CMD" | grep -q 'scripts/quiet.py'; then echo '[quiet hint] git diff/log can be huge — consider: python3 scripts/quiet.py git ...' >&2; fi
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if [ -f .queue_top3.md ]; then cat .queue_top3.md; else echo '(run: python3 scripts/queue.py)'; fi
